verdict.rationale: Apify's own Actors take a list of inputs (a startUrls array with a crawl-page limit) and process them in one run. The docs also describe merging datasets for export in several formats, which is a form of bulk processing across many items. However, no evidence documents explicit bulk or batch operations such as mass update, delete or batch-run endpoints. missing for 10: explicit documented bulk/batch API operations (batch update/delete/run across many items), AI-native bulk workflow evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: This merged dataset can then be exported into various formats such as CSV, JSON, XLSX, or XML.
Multiple input schemas for one Actor can be persisted in tasks.
